title: Where Life Flows with Serenity... T3 Home in Pêra with Sea View Fully
description:
Fully renovated villa in Vila de Pêra, composed of three independent units (T1 on the ground floor, exterior suite, and T1 on the first floor), ideal for those seeking versatility, privacy, or rental income.

With open views of the sea, countryside, and Monchique mountains, this property offers modern comfort: underfloor heating, central vacuum, highefficiency windows, 8 photovoltaic panels, solar thermal panel, and two heat pumps supplying domestic hot water, underfloor heating, and radiators.

The ground floor features an openplan living room and kitchen, a spacious suite, and access to a panoramic terrace. The exterior suite, built from scratch, provides complete independence. On the first floor, the T1 offers unobstructed views and preinstallation for a pellet stove.

Located in a quiet residential area, just minutes from supermarkets, restaurants, school, and services. 360º solar exposure, private garden, and excellent energy efficiency.

A rare opportunity in Pêra a renovated villa, ready to move in, with three independent units and a unique atmosphere.

Financing available. 
VOLUMEMAGNATA, LDA Linked Credit Intermediary (Bank of Portugal Registration: 0008035)
